title: Wobbling Waffle Wrasse
statement: A golden, grid-patterned wrasse that swims in lazy loops and pauses now and then to wobble, as if she has just remembered something delightful. She drifts through a tank of warm amber light, soft teal plants and a teacup-shaped coral cave, where she collects tiny bubbles in her dimples and releases them with a faint, happy 'bloop'.
